title: Liquid Transfer Protocol for Plate Filling
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files with a .json extension (if needed).

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file (with a .py extension) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck for plates
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the required 9 plates from the source reservoir as indicated.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, the tip rack, and the pipette. Refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Use single tip set
steps.instruction: Employ the same set of tips for the entire protocol and ensure tip tracking is enabled across protocols.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the "Run" button in the OT App to start the liquid‑transfer protocol.
